hooks.command: d=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -c .); u=$(git log --oneline @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -c .); if [ "$d" = 0 ] && [ "$u" = 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; printf '{"systemMessage":"git: %s uncommitted file(s), %s unpushed commit(s) on %s - commit and push before you lose it"}\n' "$d" "$u" "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)"
